speaker: Doctor
text:
Welcome to your post-operative check-up. You mentioned occasional shooting ear pain and difficulty wearing earrings after your tympanoplasty; can you describe exactly where the pain is located and what triggers it?

REQUEST TEST: Otoscopy to visualize the surgical site and check for granulation tissue or earring pressure.

OBSERVATION_ATTACK.clean_observation: RESULTS: Otoscopy performed. Surgical site appears clear with no signs of granulation tissue. No visible pressure points or inflammation noted in the ear canal consistent with earring wear.
